scope: Observed-cell transcript description only; shared-source reanalysis
abundance_scale: 1e6 * sum(gene counts) / sum(all saved feature counts in the same stratum)
weighting: Ratio of sums, not mean of per-cell normalized values; deeper cells contribute more counts
denominator_rule: All labels retained; NON_CONTAMINANT excludes only labels beginning contaminant_
checks: Every saved cell total equals count-row sum
